Subject: Re: Question on retention windows & deletion/egress on termination

Hi Devon — thanks for the clear list. Summary answers up front, details below:

- Hybrid retention per data class: yes, we can support per-asset-class retention windows (e.g., embeddings, logs, KV cache).
- Termination export + deletion: we can provide a certified export and a Certificate of Deletion; deletion from live nodes within 7 days is attainable, backups/snapshots are more nuanced but we can commit to full deletion within 30 days after acceptance of deletion request in an Order Form.
- Price/SLA impact: Custom retention profiles and the certificate-of-deletion add a one-time onboarding surcharge and a small monthly fee for extended archival retention and audit packaging.

Technical caveats and options:
1) Embeddings derived from PHI: we recommend enabling per-customer keying (KMS/HSM) so you can cryptographically rotate/revoke keys independent of data deletion. That reduces exposure and can speed certified deletion.
2) Backups & snapshot retention: our standard backup windows are daily snapshots retained 90 days. For a 30-day total deletion guarantee we will apply a special retention policy on your dedicated bucket and cascade lifecycle rules to accelerate snapshot expiry; this requires a contractual Order Form clause and an access window to your cloud object-store to perform manifest-based delete confirmations.
3) Audit cert: we will provide a signed PDF certificate listing manifests and deletion job ids; an internal forensics engineer will sign off.

Next steps I propose: I will draft specific Order Form language that: (a) declares the per-data-class retention windows, (b) defines the termination export flow + certificate timeline, and (c) lists any one-time/on-going fees. Looping Marissa for contractual language and Karthik for privacy sign-off.

Would you like the draft as redline in the order form PDF or a short addendum?

Best,
Rishi
